verses.text: And I lifted up mine eyes, and saw, and, behold, a man with a measuring line in his hand.

segments.text: And I lifted up mine eyes, and saw, and, behold, a man with a measuring line in his hand.

verses.text: Then said I, Whither goest thou? And he said unto me, To measure Jerusalem, to see what is the breadth thereof, and what is the length thereof.

segments.text: Then said I, Whither goest thou? And he said unto me, To measure Jerusalem, to see what is the breadth thereof, and what is the length thereof.

verses.text: And, behold, the angel that talked with me went forth, and another angel went out to meet him,

segments.text: And, behold, the angel that talked with me went forth, and another angel went out to meet him,

verses.text: and said unto him, Run, speak to this young man, saying, Jerusalem shall be inhabited as villages without walls, by reason of the multitude of men and cattle therein.

segments.text: and said unto him, Run, speak to this young man, saying, Jerusalem shall be inhabited as villages without walls, by reason of the multitude of men and cattle therein.

verses.text: For I, saith Jehovah, will be unto her a wall of fire round about, and I will be the glory in the midst of her.

segments.text: For I, saith Jehovah, will be unto her a wall of fire round about, and I will be the glory in the midst of her.

verses.text: Ho, ho, flee from the land of the north, saith Jehovah; for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heavens, saith Jehovah.

segments.text: Ho, ho, flee from the land of the north, saith Jehovah; for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heavens, saith Jehovah.

verses.text: Ho Zion, escape, thou that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.

segments.text: Ho Zion, escape, thou that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.

verses.text: For thus saith Jehovah of hosts: After glory hath he sent me unto the nations which plundered you; for he that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye.

segments.text: For thus saith Jehovah of hosts: After glory hath he sent me unto the nations which plundered you; for he that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye.

verses.text: For, behold, I will shake my hand over them, and they shall be a spoil to those that served them; and ye shall know that Jehovah of hosts hath sent me.

segments.text: For, behold, I will shake my hand over them, and they shall be a spoil to those that served them; and ye shall know that Jehovah of hosts hath sent me.

verses.text: Sing and rejoice, O daughter of Zion; for, lo, I come, and I will dwell in the midst of thee, saith Jehovah.

segments.text: Sing and rejoice, O daughter of Zion; for, lo, I come, and I will dwell in the midst of thee, saith Jehovah.

verses.text: And many nations shall join themselves to Jehovah in that day, and shall be my people; and I will dwell in the midst of thee, and thou shalt know that Jehovah of hosts hath sent me unto thee.

segments.text: And many nations shall join themselves to Jehovah in that day, and shall be my people; and I will dwell in the midst of thee, and thou shalt know that Jehovah of hosts hath sent me unto thee.

verses.text: And Jehovah shall inherit Judah as his portion in the holy land, and shall yet choose Jerusalem.

segments.text: And Jehovah shall inherit Judah as his portion in the holy land, and shall yet choose Jerusalem.

verses.text: Be silent, all flesh, before Jehovah; for he is waked up out of his holy habitation.

segments.text: Be silent, all flesh, before Jehovah; for he is waked up out of his holy habitation.
